title: lint + studio: follow-ups from PR #37513's contract review (data-model publish checks, nits N1 N4 N6 N7 N8 N9)
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ③ follow-up of an accepted delivery. Nits recorded by contract review PASS on PR #37513 (card #35143, Data model family) for a follow-up card; none affects correctness or the contract. One card covers the family.

- N1 — `field/count-named-lookup` fires on a lookup named after its target object (e.g. `own_total` → `own_total`); stay silent when the target's name carries the token. Advisory only.
- N4 — `lintDataModel` R8 (`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`, the `refOf(def)` arm) reads a `reference` on a select as an option source, which `field/reference-on-non-reference-type` now refuses; it also counts the undeclared keys `optionsFrom` / `dataSource`.
- N6 — the record-picker clause is still added for types the record page opens no inline editor for (`html`, `richtext`, `password`, `secret`, `vector`, `composite`, `record`, `repeater`); the docblock's "every other non-reference type falls through" is too wide by the same set.
- N7 — the set of types that keep `reference` is spelled twice (lint `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` + `REFERENCE_READ_OFF_TYPE`; designer `readsReference`); one exported source would close it.
- N8 — Studio repairs a stored stray `reference` only on an edit that writes the object's `fields`; an object-level edit still sends it and is refused. Normalise once at the save body.
- N9 — the retype pin's `rejections` check never refused this key; the header of `object-fields-io.ts` names one exception to "preserve unknown properties" where there are now two.
- Docs — the rule-family table in `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (roll-up row) has no row for `rollup/child-without-parent-reference`.
- Pre-existing, same designer function: a Studio retype from `lookup` to `user` keeps a foreign target the spec's parse refuses, and the designer draws no target picker on `user`.

Suggested-grade: p3 · polish on a landed check; N8 and the lookup→user retype are the user-reachable ones.
Dedupe: `count-named-lookup`, `readsReference`, `stripStrayReference` found only #35143 and PR #37513.
